title: Creation of a Biospecimen Repository From Patients With Interstitial Lung Diseases (ILD)
brief_summary: To develop a repository of blood samples from patients with ILD to support future studies into the development of such biomarkers. Patients with pneumonia and healthy patients will also be recruited as a control group.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a diagnosis of ILD or any fibrotic disease of the lung or a diagnosis of pneumonia
* Patients willing to provide written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwillingness/unable to give blood samples
study_population: Patients with a diagnosis of ILD or any fibrotic disease of the lung. A diagnosis of pneumonia and healthy volunteers will also be included as a control group.
